question: Refer to the exhibit. Which command must be used to restore configuration changes made by disabling the PIM feature and skipping any errors?
context:

1) pim-checkpoint:
Created by admin
Created at Tue, 00:50:29 22 Jun 2021
Size is 24,855 byte

2) system-fm-pim:
Created by admin
Created at Tue, 00:08:57 22 Jun 2021

--------------------------------------------------
Description: Created by Feature Manager.
theory: Disabling a feature such as PIM causes NX-OS to automatically generate a system checkpoint named system-fm-<feature> (here system-fm-pim) that captures the configuration being removed. Restoring that specific system checkpoint while skipping any errors uses the best-effort rollback trigger, which reapplies every line it can and simply ignores lines that fail, rather than aborting entirely (atomic) or stopping at the first failure (stop-at-first-failure); referencing a nonexistent checkpoint name like new-checkpoint would not restore the actual PIM configuration shown in the exhibit. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 6 — System-Generated Checkpoints and Rollback Trigger Types)
